messages:
Priya Kumar: quick thread — QA on autosave behavior for route-filter views during rollouts. Users keep hitting autosave when switching models. Can we have an opt-out toggle per-user?

Tom Bowers: Are you referring to the "Autosave for filters" flag or the console quicksave CTA? which one

Priya Kumar: the quicksave CTA that pops after you change route/model filters. It's set to on by default per org in rollout A. We saw +18% saved queries created — noisy. :eyes:

Danielle Li: not a fan of implicit saves. We should distinguish "save as preset" vs "save query". maybe require explicit name to save.

Marco Rinaldi: Possible technical constraint: saved-queries API is idempotent by name+scope. autosave does silent POST to /api/v1/saved_queries with auto_generated name. That breaks ownership expectations.

Alex Chen: can we change autosave to create drafts instead? user sees "Draft saved — publish?" This avoids polluting org-level lists.

deploy-bot: notice: canary rollout 12% -> 25% for feature:console-filter-autosave started by @engineering at 2024-06-18T09:12Z

Tom Bowers: draft approach sounds safer. UX: show brief inline toast + undo. backend: need draft table keyed by user_id and route_id. Shouldn't affect telemetry quotas.

Priya Kumar: Telemetry: we need to log event "autosave_attempt" with sample rate 5% to avoid quota spike. Also include route/model context so rollback metrics are meaningful.

Danielle Li: Agree on 5% sampling. Also add "user_optout" flag so we can analyze retention.

Marco Rinaldi: Implementation sketch:

```json
POST /internal/saved_queries/draft
{
  "user_id":"u_678",
  "scope":{"route":"r_123","model":"gpt-neo-2.7b"},
  "filters":[...],
  "meta":{"autosave":true}
}
```

Tom Bowers: Backend: need migration for existing autogenerated saves -> convert to drafts in canary window. Might be heavy.

Alex Chen: alternative: mark autogenerated saves with tag "autosave-draft" and hide from default org listings. Then later convert.

Priya Kumar: Ok plan: 1) stop silent POST -> create draft endpoint; 2) hide previous autosave items via tag script; 3) telemetry sampling 5%; 4) opt-out toggle in console settings. Rollout plan? :+1:

deploy-bot: canary rollout paused at 25% due to org feedback. reason: spike in saved-query count.

Danielle Li: I'll draft UX copy for draft toast + settings checkbox. Keep it short.

Marco Rinaldi: I'll write migration script and tag filter. Need SR for db ops.

Priya Kumar: thanks. I'll open follow-up thread with API contract. @Tom can you coordinate the canary un-pause after we have tag script?

Tom Bowers: Yup. I'll add checklist in the rollout ticket. :party_parrot:

Alex Chen: thumbs up.
